name: Freeway Begins Sign
description: The freeway (national road) begins at this point. Freeway rules apply: no pedestrians, cyclists, or animal-drawn vehicles.

name: Freeway Ends Sign
description: The freeway ends at this point. Urban road rules and reduced speed limits now apply.

name: Fuel Station Information Sign
description: A fuel station is located in the direction indicated. Typically shown with distance on rural roads.

name: Hospital Information Sign
description: A hospital is located in the direction indicated. Blue and white; aids navigation to medical services.

name: National Route Marker
description: Identifies a national route (N-road). Displayed in green and white; the number indicates the specific route.

name: No Through Road Sign
description: This road is a dead end — there is no exit at the far end. Used to prevent unnecessary entry.

name: One-Way Road Sign
description: Traffic flows in one direction only on this road. The arrow indicates the permitted direction of travel.

name: Parking Area Sign
description: A designated parking area is available in the direction indicated. Parking rules applicable at that site apply.

name: Regional Route Marker
description: Identifies a regional route (R-road). Displayed in blue and white; connects towns and cities within a province.

name: Rest Area Sign
description: A rest area or lay-by is ahead where drivers may stop safely to rest, use facilities, or take a break from driving.

name: Bicycle Lane Sign
description: This lane is reserved exclusively for pedal cyclists. Motor vehicles may not use a bicycle lane.

name: Bus Lane Sign
description: This lane is reserved for buses during the times indicated. Other vehicles must vacate or not enter the bus lane.

name: End Speed Restriction Sign
description: The speed restriction indicated earlier no longer applies. The applicable general limit for the road class is now in force.

name: Keep Left Sign
description: You must keep to the left side of the road or traffic island. Used to direct traffic around an obstruction or island.

name: Keep Right Sign
description: You must keep to the right side of the road or traffic island. Directs traffic to pass an obstruction on the right.

name: Mini-bus Taxi Lane Sign
description: This lane is reserved for mini-bus taxis. Other vehicles may not use this lane except to access properties or make turns where permitted.

name: No Entry Sign
description: Entry by vehicles is prohibited. You may not drive into the road or area beyond this sign.

name: No Left Turn Sign
description: Left turns are prohibited at this intersection or road. You must proceed straight or turn right if permitted.

name: No Overtaking Sign
description: Overtaking of motor vehicles is prohibited on this section of road. You may not pass another moving vehicle.

name: No Parking Sign
description: Parking is prohibited on the side of the road where this sign is displayed. You may stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.

name: No Right Turn Sign
description: Right turns are prohibited at this intersection or road. You must proceed straight or turn left if permitted.

name: No Stopping Sign
description: Stopping or parking is completely prohibited where this sign is displayed. You may not stop for any reason.

name: No U-Turn Sign
description: U-turns are prohibited at this point. You may not turn your vehicle to travel in the opposite direction.

name: Proceed Straight Sign
description: You must proceed straight ahead. You may not turn left or right at this point.

name: Speed Limit 100 km/h
description: The maximum permitted speed on this road section is 100 km/h. Typical limit on rural two-lane national roads.

name: Speed Limit 120 km/h
description: The maximum permitted speed on this road section is 120 km/h. The national maximum permitted speed for light motor vehicles on freeways.

name: Speed Limit 30 km/h
description: The maximum permitted speed on this road section is 30 km/h. You must not exceed this speed.

name: Speed Limit 60 km/h
description: The maximum permitted speed on this road section is 60 km/h. Typical urban arterial limit.

name: Speed Limit 80 km/h
description: The maximum permitted speed on this road section is 80 km/h. Common on peri-urban roads and certain national roads through towns.

name: Stop Sign
description: You must come to a complete stop at the stop line or, if there is no line, before entering the intersection. You may proceed only when it is safe to do so.

name: Traffic Signal Ahead
description: Warns drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to stop.

name: Turn Left Sign
description: You are compelled to turn left at this point. You may not proceed straight or turn right.

name: Turn Right Sign
description: You are compelled to turn right at this point. You may not proceed straight or turn left.

name: Yield / Give Way Sign
description: You must give way to traffic on the road you are entering. Slow down and stop if necessary; proceed only when it is safe.

name: Tourism Destination Sign
description: Brown tourism signs direct travellers to places of tourist interest such as nature reserves, heritage sites, museums, and scenic attractions.

name: Tourism Direction Sign
description: Directional sign for tourist destinations. Brown background with white text and icons; standard across South Africa.

name: Animals Crossing Warning Sign
description: Domestic or wild animals may cross the road ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to stop.

name: Bridge Ahead Warning Sign
description: A bridge is ahead. The bridge may be narrow — reduce speed and give way to oncoming vehicles.

name: Children Warning Sign
description: Children may be present or crossing ahead. Proceed with caution at reduced speed.

name: Loose Gravel Warning Sign
description: The road surface has loose gravel or stones. Reduce speed to prevent loss of control or windscreen damage.

name: Low Flying Aircraft Warning Sign
description: Low-flying aircraft may cross or operate near this road, typically near airfields. Be alert for aircraft and instructions.

name: Pedestrian Crossing Warning Sign
description: A pedestrian crossing is ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to stop for pedestrians.

name: Railway Crossing Warning Sign
description: A level crossing with a railway line is ahead. Reduce speed, look both ways, and stop if a train is approaching.

name: Road Narrows Warning Sign
description: The road ahead narrows. Reduce speed and be prepared to give way to oncoming traffic.

name: Road Works Warning Sign
description: Road construction or maintenance is taking place ahead. Reduce speed and obey flagmen or temporary signals.

name: School Crossing Warning Sign
description: A school crossing or school zone is ahead. Reduce speed significantly and watch for children crossing.

name: Sharp Curve Left Warning Sign
description: There is a sharp curve to the left ahead. Reduce speed before entering the curve.

name: Sharp Curve Right Warning Sign
description: There is a sharp curve to the right ahead. Reduce speed before entering the curve.

name: Slippery Road Warning Sign
description: The road surface ahead may be slippery, especially when wet. Reduce speed and avoid harsh braking or steering.

name: Steep Ascent Warning Sign
description: A steep uphill gradient lies ahead. Engage a lower gear to maintain safe progress.

name: Steep Descent Warning Sign
description: A steep downhill gradient lies ahead. Engage a lower gear and use engine braking to control speed.

name: Traffic Signals Ahead Warning Sign
description: Traffic signals are situated ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to stop at a red signal.

name: Wild Animals Warning Sign
description: Wild animals may stray onto the road in this area. Reduce speed, especially at dawn and dusk.
